# bitbucket Provider

Manages Bitbucket Cloud projects, repositories, branch restrictions, Pipelines configuration (pipeline config, variables, runners) and deployment environments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    bitbucket = {
      source  = "registry.terraform.io/JCardenasVGx/bitbucket"
      version = "~> 1.0"
    }
  }
}

# workspace, username and password can also be set via the BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE,
# BITBUCKET_USERNAME and BITBUCKET_PASSWORD environment variables instead of
# hardcoding them here.
provider "bitbucket" {
  workspace = "mi-workspace"
}

# Alternative: authenticate with a Repository/Project/Workspace Access
# Token instead of username+password (sent as "Authorization: Bearer").
# bitbucket_group and bitbucket_group_membership still need username and
# password, since Bitbucket's legacy v1.0 groups API doesn't accept Access
# Tokens — set both if you use those resources.
#
# provider "bitbucket" {
#   workspace = "mi-workspace"
#   token     = var.bitbucket_access_token # or BITBUCKET_TOKEN
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Bitbucket app password or Atlassian API token. Required unless token is set. Can also be set via BITBUCKET_PASSWORD.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) A Bitbucket Repository, Project or Workspace Access Token. Sent as "Authorization: Bearer <token>" instead of HTTP Basic Auth; takes precedence over username/password for every resource except bitbucket_group and bitbucket_group_membership, which use Bitbucket's legacy v1.0 API and don't accept Access Tokens at all — those two still need username/password even when token is set. Can also be set via BITBUCKET_TOKEN.
- `username` (String) Bitbucket username (or Atlassian account email when using an API token). Can also be set via BITBUCKET_USERNAME.
- `workspace` (String) Bitbucket Cloud workspace slug. Can also be set via the BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE environment variable.
